Compared with the grown primary Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>, the most ungrown Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> rods demonstrate higher angles θ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf> between [001]<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">βSn</inf> and [0001]<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Cu6Sn5</inf> (>38°). The abnormally less growth of low-θ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf> Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> can be attributed to the chaotic Cu diffusion flux in the neighboring region that is the result of the complex geometry of the solder joint. The formations of new Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> rods within the solder joint are influenced by the Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>-βSn orientation relationship, with small angles (<20°) between [0001]<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Cu6Sn5</inf> with ${\langle 11\bar 2\rangle _{\beta {\text{Sn}}}}$. The formation of Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> particles at the specific area of the anode interface is consistent with the local higher Cu concentration, as indicated by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on Acceleration Test Model and Parameter Determination Method of Integrated Circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: With the development of microelectronics manufacturing technology, the reliability level of electronic components has also increased rapidly. The failure rate of common commercial semiconductor chips has been as low as 10-9. It is difficult to obtain quantitative reliability data of devices by traditional reliability tests. Therefore, the accelerated life test with the advantages of higher efficiency and lower test cost has been rapidly developed in the field of reliability evaluation of electronic components. The difficulty of accelerated life test is to choose the appropriate acceleration model and determine the parameters of the model. This paper studies the characteristics and application scenarios of three acceleration models commonly used in accelerated life tests of integrated circuits— the Arrhenius model, the Coffin Manson model, and the Hallberg-Peck model. By studying the test conditions of life test, temperature cycle test and humidity test in common test standards of integrated circuits, the potential laws behind the standard conditions are excavated. Introduce the test conditions specified in the commonly used standards into the model parameter determination method: 1) For the life test, the steady-state life and aging test conditions in GJB548C-2021 are introduced into the Arrhenius model parameter determination method; 2) For the temperature cycle test, combined with JESD47G The specified test conditions are introduced into the Coffin Manson model parameter determination method; 3) The test conditions of GB/T 4937.4-2012 on the HAST test are incorporated into the Hallberg Peck model parameter determination method. The research results show that the life test conditions conform to the Arrhenius model, the temperature cycle test conditions conform to the Coffin-Manson model, the temperature and humidity comprehensive test conditions such as humidity resistance and HAST tests conform to the Hallberg-Peck model, and the corresponding model parameters are obtained through fitting calculations. It can be seen that there is a linear correlation greater than 0.95 between the two, which provides a basis and ideas for formulating an integrated circuit accelerated life evaluation plan, selecting key technical parameters such as accelerated model, accelerated stress conditions, and accelerated time.

articleTitle: Study on surge current characteristic of SiC SBD with different solder layer structure
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: In this paper, surge current characteristic of SiC SBD with different solder layer structure and the dynamic trend of junction temperature during surge current were studied by FloTHERM. It was found that different surge current and highest junction temperature difference affect surge characteristic of SiC SBD device with different solder materials and thicknesses. The SiC SBD device packaged by nanosilver has the lowest junction temperature under the same surge current due to the better heat difussion path and lager heat flux than the others. The maximum junction temperature of SiC SBD device decrease firstly and then increase with increasing solder layer thickness from 20μm to 120μm, which may be caused by volume strain energy. Meanwhile, it was seen that the highest junction temperature exhibits 1ms delay compared to the peak surge current of 5ms because the heat generated at 5ms is more than the heat flux. Based on the variation of highest junction temperature difference, the junction temperature change is related to device working state that includes unipolar conduction and bipolar conduction. It provides simulation theoretical guidance for the effect of different solder materials and thicknesses on SiC SBD devices under surge current in the future.

articleTitle: A failure analysis of solder flow in DC-DC power module
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: A failure mechanism and analysis method of DC-DC power module is presented in this paper. The inside of the DC-DC power module is a PCBA wrapped in molding compound. Because of manufacturing defects, there may be voids between the PCBA and the molding compound inside the modules. The solder on the PCBA may flow into the voids during reflow soldering of the module and bridge between different pads, causing failure. Traditional failure analysis methods, such as 2D X-Ray and chemical unsealing, are unable to accurately locate such defects and can also hinder the exposure of true profiles. 3D X-Ray, C-SAM, and mechanical grinding can be used to effectively locate the failure location, expose the failure morphology, clarify the failure causes, and put forward improvement measures.

articleTitle: An investigation on the on dielectric, ferroelectric properties and failure mechanism for the 0805X7R multi-layer ceramic capacitor
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: The BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-based multi-layer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs) has been widely used with the development of the automobile, personal computers and other electronic equipment. As the most important performance parameter of MLCCs, the reliability is mainly affected by grain size, oxygen vacancy concentration and migration energy, which has been generally accepted. However, there is not a comprehensive and profound understanding for the failure mechanism of MLCCs. Generally, the failure sample mainly shows aggregation of oxygen vacancies, resulting in a large drop in resistance. Actually, the change in the micro-structure of the failure sample can also be reflected by the dielectric and ferroelectric properties. In this work, two 0805 MLCCs devices with a BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> dielectric layer of ~4μm, including a normal sample without aging and a failed sample manifested as a resistance drop of one order after aging at 125 ℃, 37.5 V for 168 h, were investigated. We demonstrated the capacity of failure sample decreased and the dielectric loss increased comparing the normal sample. For the ferroelectric properties, all the samples show that the coercive electric field and residual polarization increase with the temperature increasing, while the symmetry of the hysteresis loop and the P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf> (Maximum polarization) decreased for the failure sample. Furthermore, we also proved that the Schottky barrier of the Ni-BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> interface layer decreased from 0.6eV to 0.4eV after aging, which was mainly caused by oxygen vacancy migration interpreted by the measurement and analysis of XPS (X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy), IV in different temperature, SKPM (Scanning Kelvin probe microcope). At last, the migration mechanism model of oxygen vacancy is established for further exploration of the failure mechanism.

articleTitle: Design Hydro-Solar-Wind Multi-energy Complementary System via Multi-Objective Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: The global energy crisis and environmental degradation have become an urgent issue, and it is imperative to develop renewable energy system to promote the transformation of the energy structure. As a highly adjustable renewable energy source, the hydroelectric energy is often integrated into photovoltaic and wind systems to improve the system performance. However, the hydropower is limited by hydrological conditions, resulting in insufficient regulation and generation capacity during the dry water period. In this work, we investigate the hydro-solar-wind multi-energy complementary system via the multi-objective optimization considering the dry, flat and rich water periods. The non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm II is adopted to realize the multi-objective optimization including minimizing the system output volatility, the difference between system output and load, and maximizing the total system power generation, aiming to obtain the optimal configuration of the energy system under different typical weather conditions. During the dry water period, the hydro-solar-wind multi-energy complementary system shows huge power deficit. The hydrological conditions affect the economy and reliability of system, which will be reduced during dry water period when the hydropower supply is insufficient. The results of this study indicate that the performance of hydro-solar-wind multi-energy complementary systems is poor during the dry water period and other energy sources need to be incorporated to improve the reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Optimized Modeling of Package Warping Phenomenon
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: The further ultra-thin packaging structure has made packaging warpage a major technical problem, which restricts the improvement of packaging yield. In response to this issue, this article proposes a new finite element modeling and simulation method that considers the time and temperature dependence of composite materials, as well as the shrinkage behavior of the Epoxy Molding Compound (EMC) and the substrate during the assembly process. The model parameters are fitted and corrected using a step-by-step simulation approximation method combined with actual warping data. The correction parameters were applied to the warping prediction of a new packaging model, and the predicted data were in good agreement with the actual test data, verifying the correctness of the modeling method, which can be used for rapid screening of packaging structures and materials.

articleTitle: Effect of current on the growth of intermetallic compounds in Sn-3.0Ag-0.5Cu solder joints
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: The increasing miniaturization of electronic products has led to an increase in current density, making the effect of current on the mechanical behavior of solder joints significant, and the accurate characterization of the mechanical behavior of solder joints as a material for connecting electronic components is important to ensure the reliability of the package structure. The failure location of solder joints often occurs at intermetallic compounds (IMC), and the effect of high current on IMC layers is not yet completely understood. For this reason, this paper investigates the effect of different current duration and temperatures on the evolution of IMC morphology under current conditions with Sn3.0Ag0.5Cu solder, which is widely used in electronic packaging, and finds that current can significantly accelerate the growth of IMC. The IMC layer thickness, grain size distribution, and interfacial microstructure were characterized, and the effect of microstructure change on the mechanical behavior of the material was investigated. The effect of current on the IMC layer is further clarified to provide a basis for the life evaluation of the package structure.

articleTitle: Simulation Application of Interconnected Structure of Microsystems Based on Artificial Neural Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: This paper mainly describes the construction process of a class of electromagnetic model simulation APP for interconnected structures of Microsystems. The driving algorithm of simulation application uses artificial neural network algorithm instead of the original electromagnetic numerical algorithm (finite element method, finite difference method, moment method). The algorithm model constructed by artificial neural network can ensure the accuracy and reliability, and the computing speed is significantly improved. The trained algorithm model is encapsulated into a simulation application through customized application design environment, which can also be easily used by microsystem designers without intelligent algorithm basis. At the initial stage of microsystem design, microsystem design engineers apply simulation application to carry out design and simulation, which can simply set geometric parameters of interconnected structures and obtain simulation result curves in a very short time. Application also supports inverse calculation for design objectives, which can greatly save the design time.

articleTitle: Effect of Zn Content on the Performance of Cu/SAC0307+xZn/Al Joints with Dual Ultrasound Assistance
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: This research explores the influence of Zn content on the performance of Cu/Al joints using a mixed powder of SAC0307+xZn as solder, and employs dual ultrasonic assistance during experimentation. Cu/Al dissimilar materials were successfully soldered at a low temperature of 220℃ with the help of dual ultrasound assistance. According to the results, a continuous Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>Zn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</inf>/CuZn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> intermetallic compound (IMC) was formed at the interface of the Cu side for all Cu/Al joints. And an Al-Zn solid solution was formed on the aluminum side. The ultrasonic energy causes the Zn particles within the solder base to gather and accumulate at the interface of the Cu-side. As the Zn content increases, both the thickness of IMC and the solid solubility of Zn in a solid solution also exhibit an upward trend. However, the shear strength of Cu/Al joints increases first and then decreases. When the Zn content was 30wt.%, a uniform dense Cu/Al joint was formed and the shear strength of joints reached the maximum (35.6MPa). The analysis of fracture morphology demonstrates that the fracture site of Cu/Al joints is in the soldering base. The high Zn content can result in voids and other defects between the Zn particles, thereby reducing the shear strength of the solder joint.

articleTitle: Research on TSV Stress of Ultra-thin Optical Fingerprint Chip
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: With the rapid development of consumer electronics and other industries, the packaging of ultra-thin optical fingerprint chips is constantly developing towards smaller packages. TSV is an effective means to realize ultra-thin fingerprint chip packaging. In order to solve the phenomenon of the stress of TSV of the existing ultra-thin optical fingerprint chip which has led to the delamination of copper and polyamide (PA) after temperature cycling (TC) in the existing package, this paper adopts the method of finite element simulation to establish two models of slope metal-free and metal interconnection. Through the simulation results, it can be found that the metal interconnection structure can make the PA in a state of uniform stress distribution at the bottom of the groove; for the model structure without metal on the slope, the metal and the upper surface of the PA will not form stress locations, but compared with the original model, it increases about 25.7% the stress of PA at the bottom corner of the groove, so it is easy to cause the fracture of PA.

articleTitle: Optimization analysis of high-speed differential signal vias in package
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: As the operating frequency of high-speed signals in the package continues to increase, the rise time of signal continues to shorten, resulting in an increasingly significant impact on signal quality. In particular, for via structures of the large-size and high-multilayer substrate in the integrated circuit (IC) package, as the frequency increases and the rise time shortens, the via holes impedance is discontinuous, and parasitic capacitance and inductance can cause signal reflection and attenuation, leading to signal integrity problems. In this study, the three-dimensional modeling of differential vias, and the parameterization of its model data are performed by HFSS software. According to the different design requirements in the early stage of IC package design, the differential vias center distance, via, pads , and anti-pads are quickly parametrically swept to simulate the TDR impedance and S-parameters under different variables. Further optimize the via structure by analyzing the signal integrity problem caused by the via structure providing support and guidance for the subsequent packaging design.

articleTitle: A stress evaluation approach for the silicon with nano-TSVs by Raman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: Nano-TSV (Through Silicon Via) is a three-dimensional integrated vertical interconnect technology to increase the interconnect density, to improve chip performances with reducing chip power consumption. As the array of Nano- TSVs is much closer to the functional area of the chip, the thermal stress is critical to the transistors on the silicon surface due to the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) mismatch between the silicon and the copper filled in nano-TSV. In this study, we present a new method for stress evaluation of the silicon with nano-TSVs using Raman microscopy. Taking the advantages of dimensionless analysis and similarity criterion, the method estimates the stress variation in the small silicon region with nano-TSVs by the testing results from the micro- TSVs by Raman microscopies. The results help to put forward solutions to reduce stress and improve the reliability of advanced 3D integration.

articleTitle: Influences of bonding process parameters on mechanical properties of the Micro-LED device
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: The influences of bonding process parameters on mechanical properties of Micro-LED light emitting device were investigated by finite element simulation, bonding experiment, and shear tests. The total deformation of the surface of the In bump after bonding process was analyzed by finite element method. Anand constitutive model was used to characterize the viscoplastic behavior of In bumps during the bonding process. All Micro-LED chips within the 30×8 Micro-LED light-emitting devices array are luminous. The average shear strength of the Micro-LED device increases significantly with bonding temperature, ranging from 6.04 MPa to 58.06 MPa. The average shear strength increases initially then decreases as bonding temperature and pressure are increased further. The peak shear strengths for the samples are achieved at the bonding pressure of 50 N and bonding time of 600 s, respectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of torsional stresses in POP solder joints under constant temperature field conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: POP stacking is composed of multiple chips stacked, because of its small package size, low height, low cost and low material consumption, etc., has been widely used, so the research on its solder joints has become a hot spot. In this paper, an analytical model of POP stacked welded joints is constructed based on ANSYS simulation and analysis software, and the torsional stress of welded joints affected by various structural parameters is studied and analyzed under the condition of constant temperature field (125°C). The three factors and three levels of pad radius, solder joint radius and solder joint height were selected to design orthogonal tests, and based on ANOVA, the most significant factor affecting the magnitude of torsional stress in solder joints was the pad radius. According to the extreme difference analysis, the order of importance of each factor is: pad radius > solder joint height > solder joint radius. The best combination is: upper layer solder joint radius 0.32mm, solder joint height 0.48mm, pad radius 0.28mm; lower layer solder joint radius 0.34mm, solder joint height 0.48mm, pad radius 0.28mm, after optimization of the upper solder joint maximum stress reduction of 0.099MPa, the lower layer of the maximum stress reduction of 1.312MPa, to achieve the purpose of optimization of the structure of the solder joint parameters.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Transformation Characteristics of Primary and Secondary Fusion Switch Matched Instrument Transformer in Flexible Interconnected Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: As a representative of clean energy, distributed photovoltaic power generation system has become an ideal alternative to traditional thermal power generation by virtue of its low carbon and sustainable characteristics. However, distributed PV output power is affected by temperature and light intensity, which has the defects of volatility and randomness. In addition, distributed PV needs to be connected to the AC grid through switching devices such as converters, which greatly enhances the harmonic level of the distribution network and breaks the single power supply structure of the traditional distribution network, and it is difficult to determine the direction of the distribution network tide. Conventional distribution network protection extracts fault steady-state quantities through the current and voltage transformers installed on the lines and develops protection algorithms. However, after a large number of distributed power sources are connected, it is difficult to shortcomings in the trend direction, difficult to determine the protection rectification value, and difficult for the conventional protection method to meet the reliability requirements. In response to the above problems, primary and secondary fusion devices have been put into operation in the distribution network, in which electronic voltage and current sensors are integrated to realize the measurement of fault transient quantities, and according to the large amount of information contained in the fault transient quantities, the reliability of protection can be effectively improved. In order to study the applicability of electronic voltage and current sensors under distributed power supply access, the paper establishes a model of Rogowski coil type current sensors and capacitive voltage sensors commonly used in primary and secondary fusion equipment, and based on the above model, the amplitude-frequency characteristic curves of sensors are obtained. A distributed PV grid-connected model and an electronic voltage and current sensor model are established in PSCAD, and the effects of fault transient quantities on the transmission characteristics of the electronic voltage and current sensors are studied in case of faults occurrence. Using a broadband testing platform, voltage transformers and current transformers configured with primary and secondary fusion switches in distribution networks are tested, verifying the correctness of the theoretical analysis in this paper.

articleTitle: Complicated-trajectory Compartment EMI Shielding in SiP Modules by Dispensing Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: The inner electromagnetic interference (EMI) due to high integration is one of the main obstacles for the application of System-in-Package (SiP). So the compartment EMI shielding is necessary to ensure the normal running of each part of the SiP. For actual SiP modules, the compartment shielding materials usually possess complex trajectory. From the point of view of the difficulty of processing and reducing the waste of space, the dispensing technology shows advantages to the traditional embedded metal frames. The compartmental shielding components fabricated by piezoelectric dispensing valve followed by thermal-curing process show high machining accuracy, good filling degree and low contact resistance, which make a promotion for the miniaturization of electronic devices.

articleTitle: Stress-strain analysis and optimization of laminated solder joints under random vibration load based on Taguchi and grey correlation method
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: The formation and reliability of solder joints is the key to chip bonding technology, so the study of new types of solder joints is always a popular research topic in the field of electronic packaging. In this paper, a three-dimensional finite element analysis model is established for a new type of solder joints (laminated solder joints). Firstly, through the Taguchi method of experimental design, the effects of solder joints diameter, height, pitch and pad diameter on the stress-strain of the laminated solder joints under random vibration load are analyzed using the signal-to-noise ratio, and then the structural parameters of the solder joints are optimized by combining gray correlation analysis on the stress-strain of the laminated solder joints under random vibration load. The results show that the laminated solder joints are prone to stress concentrations at both ends of the solder joints and that the stress strain on the side of the contact surface with the PCB is greater than the stress strain on the side of the contact surface with the chip. Stress-strain clouds show that the stress-strain in the laminated solder joints gradually increases from the inside to the outside, with the highest stress-strain in the corners of the outer perimeter. The signal-to-noise analysis shows that the height of the weld joints has the greatest influence on the stress-strain of the laminated weld joints. 3.37% reduction in stress and 3.62% reduction in strain, the stress-strain values of the stacked solder joints were improved and the reliability of Taguchi and the grey correlation method was verified.

articleTitle: SIP Solder Paste via Powder Cluster Design Harvest Both Slump Resistance and Temperature Cycling Reliability
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: A patent-pending [3] new solder paste material has been developed for assembly of SiP with outstanding slump resistance without compromising the paste volume printed, and exhibit superior thermal cycling reliability and acceptable solder joint service temperature. When the Bi or In content in solder joint was more than 10 wt%, the 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> sign of melting of reflowed solder became considerably lower than 180°C, and should be categorized as low melting solders. The TCT reliability of Bi-system and In-system was equal or better than SAC305. Both solution hardening and precipitate hardening affected alloys studied here, and resulted in an increase in shear strength with increasing thermal cycling number. Although the shear strength of In-system in general was lower than Bi-system, the crack resistance of the former was considerably higher than non-In-system, and was attributed to the intrinsic ductility of In.

articleTitle: The Densification Behavior and Microwave Dielectric Properties of the CBS Glass-ceramics for LTCC Application
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: In this work, the densification behavior and microwave dielectric properties of CaO-B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> (CBS) glass under different Ca/Si ratios and B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> content were systematically studied. Additionally, the impact of sintering process on the dielectric properties was further discussed. The results indicated a significant increase in linear shrinkage from 14.9% to 51.9% as the Ca/Si ratio increasing from 0.8 to 1.5. Moreover, when the B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> contents increased from 5.5 mol% to 7.5 mol%, there was a decrease in Ts from 744.2°C to 720.8°C, ε<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf> decreased from 6.05 to 5.57, and tanδ decreased from 2.1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> to 1.4×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>. Notably, when Ca/Si = 1.0 and B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> = 7.5 mol%, the CBS glass-ceramics heated to 850°C at a heating rate of 5 °C/min for 45 min exhibited excellent microwave dielectric properties: ε<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf>=5.53 (@12.22 GHz), tanδ= 1.3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> and Q×f~ 9166 GHz.

articleTitle: A Method of ADC Circuit Noise Optimization based on A Stochastic Resonance Bistable System
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: Stochastic resonance is a counter-intuitive phenomenon in which nonlinear systems, weak signals and noise are manifested through collaborative effects, and it is widely used in electronic information and weak signal detection. In this paper, a method of filtering ADC circuit noise optimization based on stochastic resonance bistable system is proposed. The bistable system based on the stochastic resonance theory is proposed, and the noise optimization analysis of the VCO ring oscillator module in the ADC is carried out using the bistable characteristics. The test results find that the characteristics of the bistable system allow the Gaussian white noise of suitable intensity to amplify the output amplitude of weak periodic signals, increase the output frequency response of the ring voltage controlled oscillator VCO, and find a noise optimized value.

articleTitle: Contribution of sintering process to the reliability of X7R BME-MLCCs with high-voltage
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: The X7R (-55 °C - +125 °C, ≤ ±15%) BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-based base-metal-electrode multi-layer ceramic capacitors (BME-MLCCs) with high-voltage are in great demand in industry and their reliability as a crucial factor needs to be improved. In this study, we investigated the sintering parameters of different temperatures of 1280 °C, 1260 °C and 1253 °C and hydrogen atmosphere concentrations of 1% H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, 0.5% H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> (S1, S2 and S3), and analyzed their influence on the reliability of the BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> based high-voltage type BME-MLCCs. The mean grain sizes of the samples are 320 nm, 340 nm, 330 nm, respectively, which are generated by heat-treatment. S3 exhibits the best TCC characteristic of X7R and a highest level of reversible domains and irreversible domains among them from FORC investigations. High breakdown strength of 65.56 V/μm and 58.75 V/μm are obtained in S1 and S3 with high durable voltages over 100 V, directly resulting from the small grain size, high density and large insulation resistance. Moreover, the insulation resistance degradation measurement and HALT both indicate that S3 exhibits the best reliability due to the low oxygen vacancy content. The results indicate that a relative low sintering temperature of 1253 °C with a relative low hydrogen concentration of 0.5% is beneficial for the high reliability of MLCCs with high comprehensive performances.

articleTitle: Research on the improved FCS-MPC strategy for Photovoltaic grid connection Based on the O-Z source inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: In this paper, a finite state control set model predictive control (FCS-MPC) strategy was proposed for photovoltaic grid-connected control system drive of O-Z-source inverter in the two-phase stationary coordinate system. Firstly, The variable step size observation method is used to realize the photovoltaic maximum power tracking control of the Boost circuit. Secondly, The topology of the O-Z source inverter is given, and the dynamic mathematical model of O-ZSI was established using the state-space averaging method. Then, the reference value of excitation inductance current of the transformer was obtained by controlling the capacitor voltage of the O-Z-source inverter, and combining with the output power compensation of the network side.The cost objective function was constructed with the excitation inductance predicted current value to determine whether the straight-through (ST) or non-straight-through (NST) working state mode, in order to realize the boost control of DC side of O-ZSI. Finally, when the O-ZSI was in non-through (NST) working state mode, the stator voltage reference value of O-ZSI AC side was obtained by the stator current prediction equation of the grid-connected system, and cost objective function was constructed with excitation inductance current term by the basic stator voltage in the 8 switching states. The best switching state was selected to control the grid-connected system, so as to improve the control performance of the three-phase photovoltaic grid-connected system and reduce the online operation amount. The simulation results show that that the proposed control strategy could ensure the reliable and smooth operation of the photovoltaic grid-connected system, and could realize boost control of the O-Z source inverter. It could not only quickly track the maximum power point of the PV array, but also had s good grid quality, small grid voltage waveform and three-phase current total harmonics.

Author Keywords: finite state control set model predictive control

articleTitle: Warpage Analysis and Optimization of Fan-Out Panel-Level Packaging in Hygrothermal Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: Electronic products are evolving towards high integration, miniaturization, and convenience. The Fan-Out Panel Level Packaging (FOPLP) technology has gained wide recognition and acceptance in the industry due to its advantages of high integration and low cost. However, since packaging devices often operate under harsh conditions such as high and low temperatures, as well as high humidity, studying the impact of temperature and humidity on the reliability of FOPLP packaging devices is of significant importance.This paper begins by utilizing the "chip-last" manufacturing process of FOPLP to establish a scaled-down model of the "EMC (Epoxy Molding Compound) – Chip – Temporary Bonding Layer – RDL (Redistribution Layer) – Carrier" structure. Mathematical models are then developed based on thermal conduction theory and moisture diffusion theory. Subsequently, using the COMSOL Multiphysics software, the paper investigates the effects of temperature, humidity, and their coupling on device warpage and reliability, taking into account the actual operating conditions of the devices. Finally, the study examines the impact of optimization techniques such as adding stress relief grooves and adjusting the copper content in the RDL layer on device warpage and reliability issues under hygrothermal environments, and validates the findings through simulations. The research results demonstrate that both temperature and humidity induce hygrothermal stresses and expansion within the packaging device, leading to warpage and other failures. Proper implementation of stress relief grooves and controlling the copper content in the RDL layer effectively reduces warpage, mitigates thermal and moisture-induced stresses on the chip load and device, and enhances the reliability of the packaging device. The conclusions drawn in this paper provide valuable insights for reliability simulations and structural optimizations prior to the actual production of devices, thereby reducing warpage and other failures caused by hygrothermal environments, minimizing cost losses.

articleTitle: Simulation and Optimization of Large Scale Multiport Power Supply Noise for 2.5D IC
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: With the continuous development of advanced chip packaging technology, the excellent performance of packaged core power supplies plays a crucial role in the efficient operation of the entire chip. Especially for large scale 2.5D IC with high performance, the design and optimization of their core power supplies pose significant challenges.This article mainly introduces the simulation and optimization of large scale multiport core power supply noise for 2.5D IC.Among them, it mainly involves the introduction of the full link PDN Z transfer impedance and the automatic optimization method of large-scale capacitors.

articleTitle: Design Strategies of Nanofillers in Photosensitive Polyimide Nanocomposites
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: The demand for next-generation photosensitive polyimide (PSPI) is low-temperature curable and low-dielectric properties. In this paper, a curing accelerator (aminoquinoline, AQL) was used to modify submicron fluorinated carbon (FC), and prepared a submicron quinoline modified fluorinated carbon (QL-FCO) nanofiller. QL-FCO can enhance the mechanical and dielectric properties of the nanocomposites, and the quinoline groups on its surface can also promote the curing process of PSPI, so that the low-temperature cured PSPI has excellent comprehensive properties. The QL-FCO/PI cured at 200℃ have a high imidization degree (>100%), and excellent mechanical, thermal, and dielectric properties, which are better than pure PI cured at 300℃. After spin-coating, pre-baking, photolithography, development, and curing, QL-FCO/PSPI can obtain patterns with a resolution of up to 5 μm. Although there is still a small amount of filler aggregates on the pattern, it does not affect the L/S patterns.

articleTitle: Effect of Young’s modulus on the reliability of sintered silver joints: simulation and experiment
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: Sintering silver paste has attracted ever-increasing attention in the electronic packaging field due to high melting point, excellent thermal conductivity and ease of process, which is even considered as the most promising mainstream bonding material for WBG power devices. However, the high current density and high-power density of WBG power devices lead to the generation of large amounts of heat, which brings about thermal stress between sintered silver layer and die/substrate, and sintered silver joints easily suffer reliability problem. In this paper, the effect of Young’s modulus on the reliability of sintered silver will be systematically investigated from two aspects: simulation and experiment. In terms of simulation, a sequential thermodynamic coupling method based on finite element analysis (FEA) is used to investigate the reliability of sintered silver. We obtained data on the evolution of Mises stress and plastic strain for sintered silver with different Young’s modulus under power cycles (PC), and firstly found three plastic strain cumulative trends corresponding to the three Young’s modulus ranges for sintered silver and analyzed the effect of Young’s modulus on reliability based on them. Experimentally, we can obtain various microporous sintered silver with different Young’s modulus and different shear strengths by changing the sintering parameters, and their porosity and pore size distribution are counted in detail. We systematically and orderly analyze the correlation between sintering parameters, microstructure, Young’s modulus and reliability of sintered silver.

articleTitle: Optimal scheduling of microgrids based on the trading mechanism of the reputation point system method
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: Microgrid is the main form of distributed renewable energy access to distribution network, and it is an important direction for the development of new distribution network, while the improper competition and cooperation behavior among microgrids will hinder its further development. In order to prevent the improper behavior of inter-microgrid transactions, we propose an alliance transaction mechanism based on the microgrid reputation point system, and introduce green transaction points in the microgrid reputation point system. An optimal scheduling model based on the master-slave game of "Alliance-Microgrid Operator-Shared Energy Storage Operator" is constructed. In the scheduling process, the demand and supply of energy are not always equal, and the alliance will give priority to meet the energy demand of the higher ranked microgrid according to the ranking of credit points, and the microgrid whose demand is not met will purchase energy from the distribution network. Using Yalmip + CPLEX programming in MATLAB 2019b, the algorithm is solved by genetic algorithm, and the simulation results show that the proposed method effectively protects the interests of all parties, optimizes the shared energy storage charging and discharging power, reduces the charging and discharging times from 34 to 19, reduces the carbon emission cost of each microgrid, and increases the daily revenue of each microgrid by about 0.71%, 0.67%, and 2.5% respectively.

articleTitle: Optimizing surge current capability of small-signal SBD device based on Fan-out Panel Level Packaging
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: FOPLP (Fan-out Panel Level Packaging) is considered one of the most promising microelectronics packaging technologies, with its high current capacity, ultra-low parasitic parameters, and superior heat dissipation performance, all of which perfectly match the requirements for discrete semiconductor devices. In this study, a small-signal Schottky Barrier Diode (SBD) was designed and manufactured by using FOPLP technology, and a copper RDL layer was used to replace the traditional wire bonding process to realize the internal interconnection structure of the device. Based on the outstanding connection between thick copper trace and large die pad, the parasitic resistance of package is effectively optimized, and minimized the forward voltage drop (VF) of the device. At the same time, the excellent current and heat dissipation performance greatly improves the ability of the device to withstand the surge current. Compared with the traditional wire bonding (WB) structure, the small-signal Schottky diode's Peak Forward Surge Current (IFSM) capability is improved by more than 50%.

articleTitle: Study on the effect of solder flux on the reliability of ceramic Package
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: This article focuses on the failure phenomenon of large-scale data processing microsystems after screening tests, and uses finite element simulation software combined with failure samples to study their failure mechanism. The microsystem package adopts a dual cavity structure with front and back sides, with parallel seam welding sealing on the front and gold tin sealing on the back. Different simulation models were established for the dispersion of failed gold tin solder samples, and qualitative comparative simulation analysis was conducted using finite element simulation software. Research has found that the main reason for the failure of the sample is the abnormal flow of the gold tin solder during the gold tin sealing process to the metallized inclusion area of the sealing ring, resulting in solder accumulation and local stress concentration. In subsequent screening tests, the superposition of environmental stress and residual stress resulted in ceramic cracking and device leakage failure. The research results of this article clarify that the issue of solder flow during the gold tin sealing process can have an impact on the reliability of the device, and this situation should be avoided, which has a certain guiding role for subsequent reliability evaluation and sealing process.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Signal Integrity of Build-up Film Applied to IC Substrate
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: With the advent of high-speed digital era and rapid development of 5G mobile technology, electronic devices need to operate in high frequency and high-speed scenarios. Signal integrity problems such as transmission loss, reflection, impedance matching and crosstalk between signal lines become more serious. As the carrier of integrated circuit (IC) packaging, IC substrate is developing towards the direction of high performance and high integration. As an insulating medium used in IC substrate, the build-up film (BF) has great advantage for building fine lines. In order to improve the quality of signal transmission and ensure the normal operation of electronic equipment, it is necessary to study the influence of BF on multilayer substrate in the process of signal transmission.In this paper, we mainly focus on transmission loss by electrical simulation, different materials and structural parameters in both single-layer and multilayer substrate are discussed. Firstly, in single-layer differential lines structure, it is found that dissipation factor (Df) of BF has a greater influence on insertion loss (S21), while dielectric constant (Dk) of BF has little effect on S21. This is mainly due to the proportional relationship between Df and the dielectric transmission loss part of S21. Then, the benefit of line width and line distance adjustment on reducing transmission loss is also studied. However, it is found that both line width and line distance have little influence on S21 in single-layer differential lines structure. In addition, we further investigate signal integrity problems in multilayer substrate, focusing on the influence of the through via structure between different layers on signal transmission. Obvious resonance occurs in the multilayer structure containing through via, which is observed by both S21 and return loss (S11). The mechanism of resonance is analyzed in detail, it is also found that the effect of resonance can be optimized by altering the structural parameters of the hole such as increasing the aperture. Meanwhile, it shows that Dk and Df have little effect on S21 and S11. Based on the above analysis, we conclude that BF with low Dk and Df is of great significance for reducing transmission loss in high-frequency scenarios, the underlying mechanism and structural effect are also discussed in detail. This study will provide theoretical guidance and suggestions for the signal integrity of IC substrates with BF.

articleTitle: Reliability Prediction of PBGA Solder Joint under High Temperature Torsional Composite Loading Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: The electronic products are inevitably subjected to high temperature and torsional load at the same time in practical work, which brings more rigorous test to the reliability of electronic products in service. In this paper, the common PBGA chip is chosen as the research object, and its geometric model is built up. The chip size is 25mm × 25mm my × 1.16 mm, and it has 18 × 18 solder joints array. There are 324 solder joints in total. When conducting high-temperature torsional composite loading analysis on PBGA solder joints, the direct coupling method is used. Apply a displacement load of 0.5mm in the same size but opposite direction to the four corner positions of the PCB substrate in a high-temperature environment of 150 °C. After solving and analyzing, obtain the maximum van Mises stress and strain of the solder joint. Next, MATLAB software establishes a BP neural network prediction model for driving quantity items, and predicts the stress values of PBGA solder joints under composite loading. 40 combinations of solder joint morphology parameters are designed. After 1000 iterations of training; The correlation index R of the input and output is 0.96757, with a maximum error of 4.04% and a minimum error of 0.131%. The use of neural networks can effectively predict the stress value of PBGA solder joints under high-temperature torsional composite loading.

articleTitle: Electroless amorphous Ni-Cu-P deposit and the interaction between Ni-Cu-P barrier and Sn solder
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: Diffusion barriers are widely employed to impede the excessive growth of intermetallic compounds (IMCs) and enhance the reliability of solder joints. However, the commonly used amorphous Ni-P deposit, utilized as a diffusion barrier, possesses inherent defects. During the soldering process, the interaction between Sn and Ni facilitates the formation of crystalline Ni<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>P with a finely columnar structure, which provides a rapid diffusion pathway for atoms, consequently leading to accelerated interfacial reactions. Additionally, voids that arise during aging processes also affect the connection’s reliability. This paper focuses on the preparation of amorphous Ni-xCu-P (x = 0-15 wt.%) deposits, derived from Ni-P deposits, to investigate the influence of Cu content on the barrier properties of Ni-Cu-P deposits. The results demonstrate that the amorphous Ni-Cu-P deposits exhibit a smooth, dense, and lustrous surface, with the addition of Cu atoms enhancing the brightness and solderability of the deposits. Furthermore, the IMCs formed are rod-shaped (Ni, Cu)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> after soldering, and an increased Cu content significantly restricts the growth of IMCs. Hence, it can be concluded that amorphous Ni-Cu-P coatings exhibit superior barrier performance when compared to amorphous Ni-P deposits.

articleTitle: Research on NonLinear Active Disturbance Rejection Controller for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Linear Motor*
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous linear motor (PMSLM) has the characteristics of high reliability and high efficiency. Aiming at the problem that PMSLM is used in various high-precision semiconductor packaging equipment, the application environment is complex and changeable, and various disturbances directly affect its motion performance, a nonlinear active disturbance rejection control method emerged. Due to the use of extended state observer (ESO) in active disturbance rejection control (ADRC), the total disturbance can be estimated in real-time, and precise mathematical models are not strictly required in ADRC, thus the ADRC has a good load disturbance rejection performance, fast set-point tracking performance, and strong robustness. The linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) has a relatively simple structure and its parameters can be tuned with the bandwidths of observer and controller. The nonlinear active disturbance rejection control (NLADRC) has more freedom and possibility than LADRC, so it must also have better adaptability. In this paper, the PMSLM of wire bonding machine is taken as the research object. Firstly, the open loop transfer function of the system is obtained through step response experiments. Then, in order to solve the problem that using conventional observers is easy to cause the phase lag of the system, a NLADRC based on a nonlinear extended state observer(NLESO) is designed to improve the system observation accuracy for disturbances. The total disturbance inside and outside the system can be traced from ESO, and then the controller can compensate in the nonlinear state error feedback (NLSEF) section, which has a significant effect on the control effect. Finally, the results show that compared with the PID and LADRC , NLADRC has better motion control effect, which makes the system settling time shorter, the overshoot is smaller, and the anti-interference ability is stronger, which meets the needs of engineering applications.

articleTitle: A low power consumption fractal microchannel heat sink based on hierarchical ribs
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: Thermal management is a crucial factor in electronic devices with increasing power density due to the miniaturization, high power, and high performance of these devices. To meet the dual requirements of high heat flux and low power consumption, a heat sink based on a fractal microchannel with hierarchical ribs structure and multiple outlets is proposed in this work. The rib structure increases the heat dissipation performance of the heat sink by enlarging the heat transfer area and disturbing flow. However, the addition of the rib structure also narrows the microchannel, which increases the pressure drop. To further reduce the pressure drop, the hierarchical rib structure is optimized, and multiple outlets are added. The optimization of the hierarchical rib structure reduces the pressure drop by 30% without compromising the heat dissipation performance. The addition of multiple outlets reduces the power consumption, with simulation results showing that the pressure drop of four outlets is just a quarter of one outlet. Moreover, the heat uniformity is improved by the optimization. Finally, the thermal performance of one selected heat sink tested by experiment is matched the simulation results. This study provides a potential method for high heat flux with low power consumption heat dissipation. The proposed heat sink structure with hierarchical rib structures and multiple outlets has promising potential for use in electronic devices with high power density, where efficient thermal management is critical.

articleTitle: Stress-strain analysis and optimization of TSV interconnect structure parameters under thermal cyclic load loading based on bp neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: In this paper, Firstly, a three-dimensional TSV chip vertical stacking package structure finite element analysis model was established based on ANSYS software, and the model was subjected to finite element analysis under thermal cyclic loading conditions to obtain the stress-strain distribution of TSV interconnect structure; and orthogonal test design and ANOVA were performed on the TSV interconnect structure parameters and material parameters under thermal cyclic loading. The results show that the copper column diameter, copper column height and SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> layer thickness have significant effects on the stress of the TSV interconnect structure at the confidence level of 95%. Then the BP neural network prediction software was established to realize the stress prediction of TSV interconnect structure under thermal cyclic loading, and the neural network was tested by five different sets of TSV interconnect structure morphological parameters combinations, and the predicted and simulated values were evaluated with an error of x%, indicating that it can better realize the stress prediction of TSV interconnect structure under thermal cyclic loading.

articleTitle: Study on Electromigration Lifetime of Ni/solder/Cu Sandwich Structure with Different Pb Content
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: In this paper, the electromigration lifetime of Ni/solder/Cu mixed solder joints under NSMD structure at room temperature and under temperature cycling conditions was compared and investigated. It was found that the lifetime test results of lead-free solder joints were significantly greater than those of mixed solder joints and samples with lead solder joints. The addition of trace amounts of Pb to solder joints leads to a sharp decrease in the lifetime of solder joints under electromigration conditions. With the increase of Pb content, the rate of lifetime decline slows down until it becomes relatively stable. Compared to room temperature environment, the electromigration lifetime at 125℃ is significantly worse.

articleTitle: Effect of Different Proportions and Powder Sizes of Sn on The Performance of Cu-Sn TLPB Joints
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: As power devices supported by wide bandgap (WBG) semiconductor materials such as silicon carbide (SiC) and gallium nitride (GaN) are widely used in home appliances, new energy vehicles, and aerospace. At the same time, power devices are gradually becoming miniaturized and their operating temperature is up to 300°C, which is a challenge to the traditional die-attach technologies and materials. So far, the Transient Liquid Phase Bonding (TLPB) has been considered as a promising technology due to its low-temperature bonding ability and high-temperature application. In this paper, we mixed Cu powder with different types of Sn-based solders and used low-temperature TLPB technology to improve the performance of Cu-Sn TLPB joints bonded with it. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and X-ray diffractometry (XRD) were used to analyze the different types of intermetallic compounds (IMCs) and elemental distribution within the TLPB joints. We found that under the experimental prerequisites of this paper, the Cu-Sn TLPB paste obtained by mixing the Sn-based solder containing 88% Sn had the best mechanical properties (39.38 MPa), and the Cu particles within the TLPB joints reacted completely. The IMC basically transformed from Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> into Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>Sn. The mechanical properties of the TLPB joints derived from Cu-based pastes with smaller sizes of Sn powder were relatively better (27.85 MPa) for the Sn-based solder with Sn content of 42%, and the higher bismuth content resulted in a relatively lower thermal conductivity of the TLPB joints. These results provide an experimental basis for improving the TLPB process.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of bonding wire lift-off of IGBT under power cycling
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: As a key component of power electronic devices, the reliability of insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) modules has attracted widespread attention. The bond wires lift-off is the primary mode of failure of IGBT modules, and it results in a change in the electrothermal characteristic parameters, including current density, turn-on voltage, and temperature. So, this paper investigates the impact of bonding wires lift-off on electrothermal characteristic parameters of IGBT module. Firstly, A simplified IGBT FE (Finite Element) model was established. And electro-thermal analysis is simulated under the power cycle conditions. The birth and death element technique were then used to build these FE models with various numbers of bond wires. The results of the simulations of these models' electrothermal characteristic parameters were independently recorded. Finally, analyzed the electrothermal characteristic parameters of IGBT module for different models. The analysis results show that the current density on the chip-3, the maximum temperature and turn-on voltage show a significant increase with increase of bonding wire lift-off. Compared to the initial state of no wire-bond break, the turn-on voltage increases by 6.66% when the seven bond wires are broken. It provides some valuable guidance for further study on the reliability of the bond-wire.

articleTitle: Experimental study on the growth behavior of Ni3Sn4 intermetallic compound within single-layer SnAg micro solder bumps considering ultra-long time
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: As electronic devices continue to shrink and become more efficient, the miniaturization of micro-solder bumps has emerged as a crucial area of research in microelectronics. These micro-solder bumps are essential for establishing connections with extremely narrow pitches, often ranging between 10-50 microns. However, as the size of these solder joints decreases, the volume of intermetallic compounds (IMCs) increases, thereby impacting the reliability of the solder. In this study, the growth patterns of Ni3Sn4 intermetallic compounds between the copper pillar and Sn-3.5Ag micro-solder joint are investigated over several thermal aging periods. In order to observe the growth characteristics of IMC layers within the micro solder joint, the ultra-long aging time experiment with a duration exceeding 150 days is conducted under 120°C. With the aging time increasing, the Ni3Sn4 intermetallic compound is formulated and growing due to the reaction of the Ni and Sn atoms. And the Cu/Sn intermetallic compound is not found. The Ni3Sn4 IMC growth velocity is slower than the Cu/Sn IMC at the same conditions showing the Ni layer plays the role of blocking the Cu atoms diffusion. On the other hand, it is found the Ag3Sn intermetallic compound is also nucleated and growing, especially at the grain boundaries. What's more, the Sn-3.5Ag grain size increases with the increment of the aging time. At the initial time, the grain size of the Sn-3.5Ag alloy is under 1 um and the grain size will be as long as 10 um at the aging time of 150days whose mechanics properties will be much different from the initial state.

articleTitle: Simulation and Performance Test of High Bandwidth PCB Based on Multichannel Vertical Interconnection High Frequency Connector
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: With the rapid development of semiconductor industry technology, modern communication system equipment is developing towards high bandwidth, high-speed, high-density integration, and other directions. With the increasing speed of optoelectronic integrated chips, the high-speed transmission capability of packaging and test substrates directly determines the performance of the entire device. In this paper, a multichannel high-frequency test board with a 3dB bandwidth of up to 60GHz has been developed for the performance testing of high-speed multi-channel optoelectronic integrated chips [1]. Based on multi-channel high-frequency connectors, using three-dimensional electromagnetic field modeling, simulation, and optimization methods, combined with the processing characteristics of high-frequency packaging substrates, impedance matching optimization analysis was conducted for multiple discontinuous structures included in the entire high-frequency link, and excellent simulation design results were obtained [2]. After testing, the full frequency band return loss of each channel of the link is less than - 14dB, and the insertion loss value of each channel in the DC-60GHz frequency range is less than - 1.6dB. The test results are almost consistent with the simulation results, which can meet the performance testing of multi-channel integrated chips.

articleTitle: Effects of silver paste glass additive composition on co-firing behavior of silver conductor LTCC package
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: Low-temperature co-fired ceramic (LTCC) technology is widely used for the production of MCM-Cs, due to its high density, multi-function, and high-reliability packaging. The sintering temperature of LTCC is required to be below the melting point of the metal. Silver as the most commonly conductor, its co-firing compatibility with the glassy LTCC substrates needs to be evaluated. In this work, the effect of glass additive composition and characteristics on silver/LTCC co-firing behavior were studied. The lead borosilicate glass/ Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> system was selected as the LTCC ceramic (America, Dupont 951PT). Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, PbO-B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, and CaO-B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> glass were employed as additive to prepare the silver conductor paste, which was printed on the surface of LTCC green tape and co-fired to fabricate the multilayer sample. The glass viscosity and wettability, the microstructures of silver film were studied. The results showed that the suitable viscosity and wettability of glass used in silver paste is critical to the sintering densification process even the glass additive is only 1 wt%. Adjusting the composition and characteristics of glass additives in conductor paste is one of the most important ways to achieve matching cofiring in a metal conductor/ ceramic multilayer structure.

articleTitle: SEM study on the mechanism of electromigration induced Sn alloy solder joints failure
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: Electromigration of a solder joint structure will cause the joint to fail, leading to a short or open circuit and reducing package life. It is important to clarify the damage mechanism of electromigration and explore ways to extend the life of solder joints to improve reliability of electronic packaging structures. Current research on solder joint failure mainly focuses on fracture, creep, and interface cracking caused by thermal cycling. There is relatively little research on the accumulation of solder joint vacancies caused by electromigration and the mechanism of crack nucleation. The formation of voids is important in the study of micro-solder joint failure. Meso-damage mechanics analysis combined with numerical simulation was applied to the analysis of electromigration failure, to establish the criterion for formation of electromigration voids in solder joints. The effectiveness of using this method was verified by comparison of the calculated time for formation of electromigration voids in the solder joints with that of experimental results.

articleTitle: Analysis and Modeling of Electrothermal Characteristics of SiC Power Module Based on Planar Interconnection
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: The research in this paper is based on a silicon carbide power module based on the planar interconnect structure. Combined with the structure of the original design module, this paper make an experimental samples for experimental testing. In this paper, the switching performance of the module is tested by double pulse test, and then the junction temperature of the device is measured by power experiment under certain working conditions. On the basis of experiments, the electrical and thermal characteristics of silicon carbide half-bridge power module based on planar interconnection structure are modeled, and the electrical network model and the transient thermal network model are established. Finally, the electro-thermal coupling mechanism of the planar interconnection power module was analyzed in this paper. Then, based on the modeling of the electrical and thermal characteristics of the module, the electro-thermal coupling simulation was completed by using MATLAB, and the simulation results were compared with the power experiment results under the same working conditions to verify the accuracy of the electro-thermal coupling model.

articleTitle: Collapse behavior and interfacial reaction of Cu-cored solder balls experienced multiple reflows
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: The Cu-cored solder ball (CCSB) has attracted extensive attention in 3D packaging technology because of its good electrical and thermal conductivity. During high-density packaging manufacturing, solder joints may experience multiple reflows, which can easily lead to short circuit faults. In the present work, the collapse behavior of the CCSB and SAC joints experienced multiple reflows were compared. After 5 reflows, the standoff heights of the SAC305 solder joints reduced from 213 μm to 196 μm, while those of the CCSB joints were almost unchanged (from 329 μm to 326 μm). The intermetallic compounds (IMCs) at the Cu(OSP)/SAC305 interface of the SAC305 joints were thicker than those of the CCSB joints since the distance between the two substrates of the solder joints was greatly reduced by the copper ball. The IMCs at the Cu(OSP)/SAC305 interface were (Cu,Ni)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> and Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>Sn, and those at the SAC305/Cu(ENIG) interface were (Cu,Ni)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> and (Ni,Cu)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>. After 5 reflows, Ni<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>P and Ni-Sn-P layers formed at the IMC/Cu(ENIG) interface of the both solder joints.

articleTitle: Electrodeposition of Copper with Ultra-large Grains and Good Conductivity
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: Interconnection resistance has become the main factor restricting high-speed and high-frequency signal transmission due to the smaller chip size. Preparing copper interconnection materials with large grains and low content of impurities by electrodeposition is an effective way to reduce electrical resistance. However, it is challenging to obtain copper with large grains when additives are introduced in electrodeposition. It is necessary to carry out more research on electroplating additives. In this paper, the effect of current density and concentration of sodium 3-mercapto-1-propanesulfonate (MPS) and polyethylene glycol (PEG) on the microstructure of electrodeposited copper films was studied. The grain size first increased and then decreased with the increase of current density and concentration of MPS and PEG. When the current density and concentration of MPS and PEG were 1.7 A/dm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, 0.3 ppm and 50 ppm, the copper with ultralarge grains can be obtained. The length and width of the largest grain exceeded 150 μm and 50 μm, respectively. The conductivity of this copper was as high as 90.60%IACS, which is promising for high-speed copper interconnection.

articleTitle: Enhanced reliability of ultra-thin BME-MLCCs based on low oxygen vacancy by re-oxidation process
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: Base Metal Electrode Multi-layer Ceramic Capacitors (BME-MLCCs) are considered attractive devices in a variety of electrical applications, but their reliability improvement has always been a dilemma facing the industry. Here, we fabricated BME-MLCCs with ultra-thin layer of ~2 μm and the dielectric constant of ~4,000 via one re-oxidizing (S1) and three re-oxidizing (S2), and studied the influence of the re-oxidizing process on the microstructure, nonlinear dielectric performance and reliability of samples. The particle size and morphology of the product have almost no obvious change, and the reoxidation process mainly changes the distribution of doped elements, especially the aggregation of the glass phase such as Si, thus diluting the overall doping effect, resulting in small differences in the dielectric constant for the two samples. Moreover, the oxygen vacancy content of the core in the grain decreases significantly with the increase of process number of re-oxidation, but more nickel oxide products appear at the interface layer, which reduces the Schottky barrier of the product, and reduces the overall reliability of the product. This study overturned the traditional general conclusion that high oxygen vacancy concentration is detrimental to high reliability and proposed a practical method to improve the reliability of BME-MLCCs.

articleTitle: Sacrificial anode electroless plating of iron on Bi2Te3 and electrochemical analysis for thermoelectric interconnection
publicationTitle: 2023 24th International Conference on Electronic Packaging Technology (ICEPT)
abstract: Sacrificial aluminum anode strategy was developed to deposit the iron barrier layer on N-type bismuth telluride semiconductor by use of hypophosphate as reductant and citrate as complexion in a plating solution. The chemical component and grain morphology of the high-quality iron film were characterized by X-ray diffraction and scanning electron microscopy.
